title: Piccoma to Launch Short-Form Anime Category in Late May
content: Piccoma , the subsidiary of Kakao, announced on April 27 it is set to introduce a new short-form animation category titled “ANIME” in late May, expanding its platform beyond comics and novels.
author: ANN

title: K Manga Adds LDK Pink Sequel Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Thursday it has added Ayu Watanabe 's L♡DK Pink ( LDK Pink ) sequel series in English. Kodansha describes the series: Sequel to the beloved manga L♡DK!
author: ANN

title: 'Go for It, Nakamura!' Anime Reveals New Cast Member
content: The staff for the television anime of Syundei 's Go for It, Nakamura! ( Ganbare! Nakamura-kun!! ) boys-love manga revealed on Monday that Shōya Chiba will join the anime's cast as Arandō Tamura, a director and screenwriter of Hoshimi High School's drama and film club.
author: ANN

title: Let Me Fix You Short Anime Rescheduled to Mid-June Without Buta Productions, FAR
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the short anime of Sakura Kurihara 's Let Me Fix You ( Kimi o Tsumugu ) yuri manga stated on Friday that the anime is now planned to be released in mid-June.
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta, Re-Living My Life with a Boyfriend Who Doesn't Remember Me, The Darwin Incident Win 50th Kodansha Manga Awards
content: Japanese publisher Kodansha announced the winners for its 50th annual Manga Awards on Monday. Best Shōnen Manga Other nominees included Utsura nai ndesu , The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity , and Ichi the Witch .
author: ANN

title: Akira's Katsuhiro Ōtomo Establishes New Feature Animation Studio Oval Gear
content: Katsuhiro Ōtomo announced on Monday he has founded a new feature animation studio called OVAL GEAR based in Tokyo. The studio's first title is currently in production, and the studio is hiring animators and production staff.
author: ANN

title: Masami Yūki Draws New Patlabor 1-Shot Manga
content: This year's 24th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine revealed on Monday that Masami Yūki will publish a new one-shot manga story for the Patlabor franchise in the magazine's next issue on May 18. The manga will have a color opening page.
author: ANN

title: The Credits Roll Into the Sea Gets Anime Movie by Kyoto Animation in 2027
content: The Credits Roll Into the Sea manga by John Tarachine is getting an anime movie by Kyoto Animation. It is set to release in 2027 and is directed by Taichi Ishidate ( Violet Evergarden , CITY The Animation , Beyond the Boundary ). A teaser trailer was also released.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ring Author Koji Suzuki Dies at 68
content: World-renowned horror novelist Kōji Suzuki died in a hospital in Tokyo on Friday. He was 68. Suzuki was born in Hamamatsu City in 1957. The prolific writer made his professional debut with the novel Rakuen (Paradise), which shared honors in the 2nd Japan Fantasy Novel Awards in 1990.
author: ANN

title: Credits Roll Into the Sea Manga Gets Anime Film by Kyoto Animation in 2027
content: Flag Pictures announced on Monday that Kyoto Animation is adapting John Tarachine 's Credits Roll Into The Sea ( Umi ga Hashiru Endroll ) manga into an anime film opening next year. Taichi Ishidate ( Violet Evergarden , Beyond the Boundary ) is directing the anime, and Shochiku is distributing.
author: ANN
